title: Mano Padana
concept: Growing up in a society where mental health was an avoided subject, I realized the importance of communicating emotions. මනෝ පාදන, “The Mind’s Steps”, portrays a mental healing journey through cultural aspects. Initially inspired by the traditional art of Kandyan dance, I reflect my culture through design details. Hand-crafted Dumbara fabrics have been utilized to add textural and cultural value to my collection.
